77598-picturesque-views-on-the-river-wye.creator: Unknown

arxiv-2201-10978.title: Machine Learning for Food Review and Recommendation CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language processing CCS: Computing methodologies Neural networks CCS: Information systems Learning to rank CCS: Software and its engineering Software creation and management
arxiv-2201-10978.creator: Le Tan Khang, Hui Siu Cheung
arxiv-2201-10978.description: Abstract . Food reviews and recommendations have always been important for online food service websites. However, reviewing and recommending food is not simple as it is likely to be overwhelmed by disparate contexts and meanings. In this paper, we use different deep learning approaches to address the problems of sentiment analysis, automatic review tag generation, and retrieval of food reviews.

arxiv-2202-07858.title: ITTC @ TREC 2021 Clinical Trials Track
arxiv-2202-07858.creator: Hung-Thinh Truong, Yulia Otmakhova, Rahmad Mahendra, Timothy Baldwin, Jey Han Lau, Trevor Cohn, Lawrence Cavedon, Damiano Spina, Karin Verspoor
arxiv-2202-07858.description: Abstract This paper describes the submissions of the Natural Language Processing (NLP) team from the Australian Research Council Industrial Transformation Training Centre (ITTC) for Cognitive Computing in Medical Technologies to the TREC 2021 Clinical Trials Track. The task focuses on the problem of matching eligible clinical trials to topics constituting a summary of a patient’s admission notes.

arxiv-2308-14840.title: Identifying and Mitigating the Security Risks of Generative AI
arxiv-2308-14840.creator: Clark Barrett, Brad Boyd, Elie Bursztein, Nicholas Carlini, Brad Chen, Jihye Choi, Amrita Roy Chowdhury, Mihai Christodorescu, Anupam Datta, Soheil Feizi, Kathleen Fisher, Tatsunori Hashimoto, Dan Hendrycks, Somesh Jha, Daniel Kang, Florian Kerschbaum, Eric Mitchell, John Mitchell, Zulfikar Ramzan,
arxiv-2308-14840.description: Abstract Every major technical invention resurfaces the dual-use dilemma—the new technology has the potential to be used for good as well as for harm. Generative AI (GenAI) techniques, such as large language models (LLMs) and diffusion models, have shown remarkable capabilities (e.g., in-context learning, code-completion, and text-to-image generation and editing).

arxiv-2311-01127.title: First order phase transition in the few-body XY-models with surface fields
arxiv-2311-01127.creator: Xintian Wu
arxiv-2311-01127.description: Abstract We investigate the one-dimensional finite-size XY model with opposing surface fields in the X direction. Exact solutions are obtained for the two-site and three-site models, while numerical methods are employed for models with more than three sites. Remarkably, first-order quantum phase transitions are observed in this system.

arxiv-2311-02571.title: Link residual closeness of graphs with fixed parameters
arxiv-2311-02571.creator: Leyou Xu, Chengli Li, Bo Zhou
arxiv-2311-02571.description: Abstract Link residual closeness is a newly proposed measure for network vulnerability. In this model, vertices are perfectly reliable and the links fail independently of each other. It measures the vulnerability even when the removal of links does not disconnect the graph.

arxiv-2312-07113.title: Hybrid stars in light of the HESS J1731-347 remnant and the PREX-II experiment
arxiv-2312-07113.creator: P. Laskos-Patkos, P.S. Koliogiannis, Ch.C. Moustakidis
arxiv-2312-07113.description: Abstract The recent analysis on the central compact object in the HESS J1731-347 remnant suggests interestingly small values for its mass and radius. Such an observation favors soft nuclear models that may be challenged by the observation of massive compact stars.

arxiv-2408-09531.title: Swift Trust in Mobile Ad Hoc Human-Robot Teams Conference: Second International Symposium on Trustworthy Autonomous Systems; September 16–18, 2024; Austin, TX, USA Second International Symposium on Trustworthy Autonomous Systems (TAS ’24), September 16–18, 2024, Austin, TX, USA DOI: 10.1145/3686038.
arxiv-2408-09531.creator: Sanja Milivojevic, Mehdi Sobhani, Nicola Webb, Zachary Madin, James Ward, Sagir Yusuf, Chris Baber, Edmund R. Hunt
arxiv-2408-09531.description: Abstract . Integrating robots into teams of humans is anticipated to bring significant capability improvements for tasks such as searching potentially hazardous buildings. Trust between humans and robots is recognized as a key enabler for human-robot teaming (HRT) activity: if trust during a mission falls below sufficient levels for cooperative tasks to be completed, it could critically affect success.

arxiv-2409-02962.title: Quantum wavepackets: Proofs (almost) without words
arxiv-2409-02962.creator: Yuxi Liu
arxiv-2409-02962.description: Abstract We present a geometrical way of understanding the dynamics of wavefunctions in a free space, using the phase-space formulation of quantum mechanics. By visualizing the Wigner function, the spreading, shearing, the so-called “negative probability flow” of wavefunctions, and the long-time asymptotic dispersion, are intuited visually.

arxiv-2508-17689.title: On the Edge of Memorization in Diffusion Models
arxiv-2508-17689.creator: Sam BuchananTTIC, Druv PaiUC BerkeleyYi MaUC Berkeley, HKUValentin De BortoliGoogle DeepMind
arxiv-2508-17689.description: Abstract When do diffusion models reproduce their training data, and when are they able to generate samples beyond it? A practically relevant theoretical understanding of this interplay between memorization and generalization may significantly impact real-world deployments of diffusion models with respect to issues such as copyright infringement and data privacy.

britannica-1911-morpheus.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-morpheus.description: Article 'Morpheus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. He was a personification, apparently invented by Ovid (Metam. 635), of the power that calls up human shapes ( μορφαί ) of all kinds to the dreamer. His brothers Phobetor and Phantasus assumed the forms of all kinds of animals and inanimate things.

pmc-10574150.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Analysis of Catharanthus roseus Receptor-like Kinase 1-like Proteins in Eggplant
pmc-10574150.creator: Wenpeng Ma, Juan Du, Xinlong Yu, Kai Chen, Yucheng Ming, Libo Jiang, Tong Chen, Dongchao Ji, Gianni Barcaccia
pmc-10574150.description: As an important member of the plant receptor-like kinases, Catharanthus roseus receptor-like kinase 1-like (CrRLK1L) plays vital roles in plant growth and development, as well as biotic and abiotic stress response. Numerous CrRLK1Ls have been identified and analyzed in various plant species, while our knowledge about eggplant (Solanum melongena L.) CrRLK1Ls is still scarce.

pmc-10666668.title: Breast Cancer in Pregnant Young Women: Clinicopathological Profile, Survival, and Pregnancy Outcomes
pmc-10666668.creator: Nicolas Ramírez-Torres, Rodolfo Rivas-Ruiz, Alfonso Reyes-López
pmc-10666668.description: BackgroundBreast cancer is one of the most common cancer types diagnosed during pregnancy; the presence of any neoplasm in pregnant women faces clinical dilemmas and challenges in cancer and pregnancy management. Pregnancy-associated breast cancer (PABC) is defined as breast cancer diagnosed during pregnancy or within one year after delivery.

pmc-11408524.title: Exosomal fragment enclosed polyamine-salt nano-complex for co-delivery of docetaxel and mir-34a exhibits higher cytotoxicity and apoptosis in breast cancer cells
pmc-11408524.creator: Moumita Basak, Mrunal Kulkarni, Saibhargav Narisepalli, Deepak Chitkara, Anupama Mittal
pmc-11408524.description: A novel core–shell nanocarrier system has been designed for co-delivery of a small anticancer drug, docetaxel (DTX) and tumor suppressor (TS) miR-34a named as Exo(PAN34a+DTX). The core is formed by pH dependent polyamine salt aggregates (PSA) containing both the payloads and the shell is formed by RAW 264.7 cell derived exosomal fragments.

pmc-11433041.title: Dual-Action Calcium Monoaluminate Enabled Room-Temperature Curing of Inorganic Phosphate-Based High-Temperature Adhesive
pmc-11433041.creator: Zhuo Dong, Lei Zhang, Ke Yang, Zhenggang Fang, Yaru Ni, Yang Li, Chunhua Lu, Ricardo J C Carbas
pmc-11433041.description: High-temperature adhesives find extensive application in diverse domains, encompassing repairs, production processes, and material joining. However, achieving their curing at ambient temperatures remains a formidable challenge due to the inherent requirement of elevated temperatures, typically exceeding 500 °C, for the curing reaction.

pmc-11495001.title: Enhanced bone cement distribution in percutaneous vertebroplasty using a curved guide wire: a propensity score matching analysis
pmc-11495001.creator: Xuyan Hu, Zijin Zhang, Yisong Yang, Gang Zhang, Shen Cao, Bing Yu, Yubing Zhang
pmc-11495001.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundOsteoporotic vertebral compression fractures (OVCF) severely affect the quality of life in the aged population. Percutaneous vertebroplasty (PVP) alleviates pain and stabilizes vertebrae, but suboptimal bone cement distribution can cause complications. Hence, this study aimed to clarify whether a new technique for PVP, using a curved guide wire, enhances the distribution of bone cement and improves clinical outcomes in patients with OVCF.MethodsPatients with single-segment OVCF underwent PVP or curved guide wire percutaneous vertebroplasty (C-PVP).

pmc-12784845.title: Effect of Lactobacillus reuteri Postbiotics on Growth Performance and Intestinal Health of Escherichia coli-Infected Broilers
pmc-12784845.creator: Changwu Li, Jiarou Fan, Yafei Zhang, Yu Zhang, Jiakun Yan, Peng Li, Shuangshuang Guo, Binying Ding
pmc-12784845.description: Simple SummaryLactobacilli, among the most common probiotics in the broiler intestinal tract, play a key role in maintaining intestinal homeostasis and improving growth performance. In this study, we observed that dietary Lactobacillus reuteri postbiotics ameliorated E. coli-induced mild jejunal barrier damage by up-regulating tight junction proteins and anti-inflammatory cytokines.

pmc-12859554.title: Engineered mesenchymal stem cells-laden chondroitin sulfate hydrogel promotes diabetic wound healing through ROS scavenging and macrophage polarization
pmc-12859554.creator: Xi Cao, Ziqi Shen, Xiaohua Wang, Yuanyuan Chu, Runkong Wang, Liyang Zhu, Ruixue Zhong, Zhong Zhang, Mingquan Wu, Xu Zhou, Lei Zhang
pmc-12859554.description: The treatment of diabetic wound complications has long been a formidable challenge in the clinic, and a multifunctional biomaterial dressing holds great promise as an ideal approach for promoting diabetic wound healing. In this study, we designed a crosslinked chondroitin sulfate (CS) and polyethylene glycol (PEG) hydrogel (CS gel) as a reservoir via a Michael addition reaction.

pmc-12970318.title: Endovascular treatment for symptomatic vasospasm following traumatic brain injury: illustrative case
pmc-12970318.creator: Risa Kubota, Shigeki Nakano, Masaaki Kubota, Yosuke Tajima, Kyoko Aoyagi, Kentaro Horiguchi, Yoshinori Higuchi
pmc-12970318.description: BACKGROUNDThe optimal treatment for cerebral vasospasm (CV) following traumatic brain injury (TBI) has not been established, and management generally follows strategies developed for aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage.OBSERVATIONSThe authors report a case of a patient with traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage and cerebral contusion who presented with worsening consciousness and disorientation and subsequently developed symptomatic CV on day 6 of hospitalization.

pmc-13008931.title: An experimental evaluation of an AI-powered interactive learning platform
pmc-13008931.creator: Courtney Heldreth, Diana Akrong, Laura M. Vardoulakis, Nicole E. Miller, Yael Haramaty, Lior Belinsky, Lidan Hackmon, Abraham Ortiz Tapia, Lucy Tootill, Scott Siebert
pmc-13008931.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Generative AI, which is capable of transforming static content into dynamic learning experiences, holds the potential to revolutionize student engagement in educational contexts. However, questions still remain around whether or not these tools are effective at facilitating student learning. In this research, we test the effectiveness of an AI-powered platform incorporating multiple representations and assessment through Learn Your Way, an experimental research platform that transforms textbook chapters into dynamic visual and audio representations.

pmc-13209127.title: Biologic Therapy and Surgical Management in Crohn’s Disease: Postoperative Outcomes and Biologic Management Patterns in a Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13209127.creator: Constantin-Alexandru Petraru, Tudor Stroie, Doina Istratescu, Dan Pitigoi, Corina Gabriela Meianu, Rucsandra Ilinca-Diculescu, Mircea Diculescu
pmc-13209127.description: Background and Objectives: The therapeutic role of surgery in Crohn’s disease has evolved in the era of advanced biologic therapies, particularly in patients with complex and treatment-refractory disease. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between preoperative biologic exposure and surgical outcomes, with a focus on predictors of more extensive surgical procedures, postoperative biological response, and postoperative biologic management.

pmc-13429585.title: Trends in maternal mortality in China and Hainan Province: an analysis based on GBD 2023 and Hainan surveillance data
pmc-13429585.creator: Ruili Chen, Xuejiao Li, Guihua Wu, Humin Gong
pmc-13429585.description: ObjectiveTo examine long-term trends in maternal mortality ratio (MMR) in China (1990–2023) and Hainan Province (2003–2023), characterize age-specific and cause-specific patterns, and assess the impact of major policy events on MMR trends.MethodsData were obtained from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 and Hainan provincial maternal mortality surveillance records.

pmc-13623264.title: Food-associated sexual arousal in psychiatric disorders: A case series
pmc-13623264.creator: Rajiv Mehta, Payal Tulsan, Anurag Sengar, Suyash Shendye
pmc-13623264.description: Background:Food-associated sexual arousal, frequently termed sitophilia, is a rarely reported phenomenon with no established diagnostic validity or prevalence data.Cases:We describe it, in exploratory terms, as a secondary phenomenon across three psychiatric presentations. Three patients from a tertiary care psychiatry outpatient service were assessed through clinical interview and ICD-11 criteria.
